claim: Wrong control-loop settings -- the position, velocity and acceleration loop gains and time constants, and the trajectory limits -- can make the piezo stage unstable and damage it mechanically, and such damage is not covered by the manufacturer's warranty.
validity_conditions: Read from Nanobench 6000 Customer Interface Software User Manual, PS-000006-UM issue 4 / v1.0.19 (sha256 2acb47b5...): printed page 12 (PDF page 12), printed page 30 (PDF page 30), printed page 31 (PDF page 31). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. These manuals are for the controller's software; the archive holds no hardware manual for the stage or the controller. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
